title: The MOS 6567/6569 video controller (VIC-II)
notes: The author describes the VIC-II registers, display modes, sprite DMA and raster timing. Sections 3.5 and 3.6 cover bad lines and memory access.

title: Covert Bitops C64 development notes
citation: Lasse Öörni (Cadaver), Covert Bitops. Dated entries.
notes: The author records game development decisions. The notes discuss sprite multiplexer load and limits on the number of active enemies.

title: C64 Game Framework sprite code
notes: The assembly describes how one logical sprite can use one or more physical sprites. DrawLogicalSpriteDir and DrawLogicalSprite are the drawing entry points.
